name: C# Jupyter: случайность в играх
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y python3-venv && python3 -m venv $HOME/.venv && $HOME/.venv/bin/pip install jupyter && dotnet tool install -g Microsoft.dotnet-interactive && PATH=$HOME/.venv/bin:$PATH $HOME/.dotnet/tools/dotnet-interactive jupyter install
